name: impact
description: Maps merkle diff to affected beads: reads bead metadata, matches changed nodes, classifies actions (create/obsolete).

requirements.title: Read bead metadata
requirements.description: Read spec-related fields from bead metadata: metadata.component, metadata.impl_section, metadata.module, metadata.spec_hash.

requirements.title: Match changed nodes to beads
requirements.description: Correlate changed spec nodes (from merkle diff) with existing beads using spec metadata fields.

requirements.title: Classify actions
requirements.description: Determine action for each affected bead: create (added or modified spec nodes) or obsolete (modified or removed spec nodes with existing beads). Modified nodes trigger both obsolete and create.

requirements.title: Output impact report
requirements.description: Produce a structured JSON impact report listing all affected beads and their classified actions (create or obsolete).

requirements.title: Deterministic matching
requirements.description: Same merkle diff + same bead state always produces the same impact report.

requirements.title: Classify cleanup actions for removed nodes
requirements.description: When a removed spec node has a closed bead (code shipped to main), classify as obsolete + cleanup create. When the bead is open or in_progress (no code shipped), classify as obsolete only.

requirements.title: Resolve spec-graph dependencies for create actions
requirements.description: For each create action, resolve uses (intra-module component edges) and requires_module (inter-module edges, transitive) to current bead IDs via the mapping file. Attach resolved open-bead dependency IDs to the action for downstream propagation to bead CLI --deps depends: flags.

requirements.title: Validate diff input
requirements.description: Before processing, check if the diff input contains errors (from change completeness validation). If errors are present, refuse to proceed — print errors to stderr and exit non-zero.

requirements.title: Data flow contract bead gating
requirements.description: Produce a create action with node_type=data_flow for every added or modified data_flow change (contract-level impact). Filter test_section changes by the describes array length in the current module spec: len(describes) >= 2 produces a task action, len(describes) == 1 is skipped (bundled into the single described component's feature bead). For every component create action whose spec node appears in a changed data_flow's uses array, resolve the data_flow bead into its DepBeadIDs via the mapping store so apply's topological ordering creates the data_flow bead first and participating component beads gain --deps depends: on it.

components.name: BeadReader
components.description: Reads bead metadata from the bead CLI (br or bd). Extracts the mapping record ID from the simplified bead label (spex:<record-id>) and bead status for correlation with spec nodes and cleanup classification.

components.name: NodeMatcher
components.description: Matches changed spec nodes to beads using spec node IDs from the ID-based merkle diff. Correlates by matching spec node IDs against mapping record IDs, not by parsing paths or label conventions. Skips structural-level changes (module.json, project.json, requirement leaves) but forwards contract-level changes (data_flow leaves) to the action classifier so a dedicated data_flow task bead is produced.

components.name: ActionClassifier
components.description: Determines the action (create/obsolete) for each matched or unmatched spec node using a simplified state transition table: added→create, modified→obsolete+create, removed→obsolete. For removed nodes with closed beads, also creates a cleanup bead. For create actions, resolves spec-graph dependencies (uses and requires_module edges) to current bead IDs via the mapping file. Gates bead creation by node type: module, component, data_flow, and test_section produce beads; impl_section is always skipped; test_section is additionally gated by its describes array length — if len(describes) == 1 the test is bundled with that component's feature bead (no separate task), if len(describes) >= 2 a cross-component task bead is produced. Data_flow nodes always produce a task bead because they describe cross-component contracts.

components.name: ReportGenerator
components.description: Produces the structured JSON impact report from classified actions. Reports two action types: create and obsolete. Create actions include the DepBeadIDs field carrying resolved spec-graph dependency bead IDs.

components.name: ImpactCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex impact. Reads merkle diff, validates diff input for errors, wires BeadReader, NodeMatcher, ActionClassifier, ReportGenerator, outputs impact report as JSON.

data_flows.name: Impact analysis flow
data_flows.description: Merkle diff + bead metadata → matched pairs → classified actions (create/obsolete) → impact report.
